method: Each 90.42 parent was rebuilt with the updated compatibility rules and matched the pre-edit live hash. build_from applied the three 90.43 components, reached the standard pipeline fixed point, round-tripped runtime IDs, and installed the matching candidates.

variants.description_reviewed: WASD movement, gyro aiming, right-stick turn assist, and circular trackpad scrolling. L2/R2: mouse buttons; L1/R1: modifiers. Includes Fn controls, Steering, Cursor Gyro, and Gamepad modes.
